name: martian
pov: 1st person (journal/log entries) interwoven with 3rd limited omniscient (external world scenes)
voice_summary: The first-person voice is sardonic, self-deprecating, and hyper-rational — the protagonist deflects existential dread with technical problem-solving and dry wit. Sentences are short and punchy in the log entries; irony is weaponized constantly ('이 행성 최고의 식물학자'). Third-person scenes adopt a cinematic, procedural rhythm — cut-to-cut like a docudrama, building tension through jargon-laden real-time reporting. The tonal contrast between the intimate diary voice and the cold broadcast voice creates emotional whiplash that sustains engagement.
